t: ShankhNaad user guide.
Meetings menu: In a call or meeting.
This is the call window, for calls from chat and for meetings.
In this video, you will learn how to use your microphone and camera, share your screen, react, chat, and see who joined.
At the top are the meeting name, the live timer, and the people in the call.
In the middle is everyone's video. A green frame shows who is speaking.
On the right is the People panel.
Press Mute to turn your microphone off and on. Stop video turns your camera off.
Share shows your screen, a window, or a browser tab with its sound.
Hold turns off your microphone, camera and the call's sound for a moment, for example to take another call.
Raise puts your hand up. Raised hands move to the top of People.
React sends a quick reaction that everyone sees.
Chat messages everyone in the call. Messages and files stay with the meeting.
Inbox shows your other chats, without leaving the call.
People lists everyone in the call. Add people calls more people in, and the Attendance sheet shows who joined, and for how long.
Copy guest link copies the link for people outside your company. They wait in the lobby until you let them in.
Captions shows live captions, Grid shows everyone in tiles, and Full screen fills your screen.
Press Leave when you are done. The organiser can also end the call for everyone.
That completes the In a call or meeting page.
